note: Sourcing pass S1 (issue 33): US government footage for the news parts, read on 2026-11-13. VOA, DVIDS and Commons were searched; the pins here are the White House's own videos as Wikimedia Commons holds them (a federal work by the source page). VOA's two 2026 video pages carry AP, AFP and C-SPAN marks on every shot that shows a beat, and DVIDS's one fitting video (1029004, 7 Nov) is credited "Courtesy", so neither is pinned. Fit first: a pin names the beat, why the picture shows it, and the seconds that do; every item was public before the beat's horizon. Nothing here is a rights decision; the fetcher checks every candidate.
